task: t12 first controlled generation pilot with roles A/B/C and external screen
gate_order: 3 single read-only PostgreSQL SELECT, executed, 1-200 rows, stable twice

roles.A: case author: intent, public_facts, evidence, reference_sql, comparison, confounders
roles.B: question author: sees intent, public_facts, glossary, evidence only; returns needs_facts when a fact is missing
roles.C: independent solver: sees only schema, question and evidence

generation.execution_backend: live PostgreSQL 15.15 through the SSH tunnel; pilot-local families run on throw-away TEMP tables with seeded fixtures

a_c_disagreements.note: kept with both SQLs, never resolved silently; they are not counted as hard rejects

examples.reference_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT rb.state, rb.brandname, COUNT(rr.starrating) AS review_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rb.state ORDER BY COUNT(rr.starrating) DESC, rb.brandname ASC) AS rn FROM rootbeerbrand rb JOIN rootbeerreview rr ON rb.brandid = rr.brandid GROUP BY rb.state, rb.brandname) SELECT state, brandname, review_count FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY state, rn;
examples.solver_sql: WITH brand_reviews AS (SELECT rbbr.brandname, rbbr.state, COUNT(rbr.review) AS review_count FROM rootbeerbrand rbbr JOIN rootbeerreview rbr ON rbbr.brandid = rbr.brandid GROUP BY rbbr.brandname, rbbr.state), ranked AS (SELECT brandname, state, review_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY review_count DESC) AS rank FROM brand_reviews) SELECT state, brandname, review_count FROM ranked WHERE rank <= 2 ORDER BY state, rank, review_count DESC, brandname;

examples.reference_sql: SELECT w.alderman_first_name, w.alderman_last_name, COUNT(c.report_no) FROM crime c JOIN ward w ON c.ward_no = w.ward_no GROUP BY w.alderman_first_name, w.alderman_last_name;
examples.solver_sql: SELECT c.ward_no, w.alderman_first_name, w.alderman_last_name, COUNT(c.report_no) AS crime_count FROM crime c JOIN ward w ON c.ward_no = w.ward_no WHERE c.arrest = 'TRUE' GROUP BY c.ward_no, w.alderman_first_name, w.alderman_last_name

examples.reference_sql: SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, SUM(v.fine) AS total_fines, SUM(SUM(v.fine)) OVER (ORDER BY SUM(v.fine) DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_fines FROM employee e JOIN inspection i ON e.employee_id = i.employee_id JOIN violation v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY total_fines DESC;
examples.solver_sql: SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, SUM(v.fine) AS total_fines FROM employee e JOIN inspection i ON e.employee_id = i.employee_id JOIN violation v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY total_fines DESC

examples.reference_sql: SELECT c.country, d.car_name, p.price FROM data d JOIN production pr ON d.id = pr.id JOIN country c ON pr.country = c.origin JOIN price p ON d.id = p.id ORDER BY c.country, p.price DESC, d.car_name ASC LIMIT 3;
examples.solver_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT c.country, d.car_name, p.price, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.country ORDER BY p.price DESC) AS rnk FROM data d JOIN production pr ON d.id = pr.id JOIN country c ON pr.country = c.origin JOIN price p ON d.id = p.id) SELECT country, car_name, price FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY country, price DESC

caveats: the local judge is a single temperature-0 pass of a quantized model; verdicts are a screening signal, not a substitute for the fixture-and-mutant validator (t13)
row caps are policed mechanically because the same model failed to detect them on control pairs in the t6 audit
pilot-local families are project-authored PostgreSQL-native schemas; they exist only because the train schemas are SQLite-translated and carry no timestamptz, JSONB or array columns
external rows carry no evidence text, so an evidence-gap flag is reported instead of a reject for them
